This template is to be used for citing individual pages on [[Atomic Mass Games]]' [https://www.atomicmassgames.com official website].

==Usage==
Copy the template code below and paste it into the appropriate place in an article, fill the required fields, and remove any that you don't use.

<code><nowiki>{{AtomicMassGames|subdomain=|url=|text=|int=|author=|date=|archivedate=|archiveurl=|archivefile=|nobackup=|nolive=}}</nowiki></code>

All fields need to be explicitly assigned to; otherwise, use of the "=" symbol in the URLs messes up the template.

===Required parameters===
*{{Para|url}} The URL of the page, minus <code><nowiki>https://www.atomicmassgames.com/</nowiki></code>.
*{{Para|text}} The formatted text to display.
*For '''archive''' options, see [[#Backup links|Backup links]] below.

===Optional parameters===
*{{Para|subdomain}} If the URL is a subdomain of atomicmassgames.com, the subdomain can be specified. Default is <code><nowiki>www</nowiki></code> if left blank.
*{{Para|int}} This field provides a link to the [[Wookieepedia]] article, if one exists.
*{{Para|author}} Name(s) of the author(s). Multiple authors must be separated with a "<code>;</code>" between their names. Note that an author is not necessarily an individual and could be an organization. A long list of authors can be reduced using "<code>, et al.</code>" after the first name. Provide wikilinks whenever they are available.
*{{Para|date}} Full date of publication, in [[Wikipedia:ISO 8601|ISO 8601]] <code>YYYY-MM-DD</code> format, for example "<code>|date=2006-02-17</code>".
*{{Para|nolive}} When the original online content is no longer available, add "<code>|nolive=1</code>".
*{{Para|oldversion}} When the current version of the page no longer includes the target information, add <code>|oldversion=1</code>

==Example(s)==
<code><nowiki>{{AtomicMassGames|url=x-wing-transmissions/star-wars-x-wing-the-battle-of-yavin|text=Star Wars: X-Wing &ndash; The Battle of Yavin|author=William Shick|date=2022-06-09|archivedate=20220614191603}}</nowiki></code>

Results in:

{{AtomicMassGames|url=x-wing-transmissions/star-wars-x-wing-the-battle-of-yavin|text=Star Wars: X-Wing &ndash; The Battle of Yavin|author=William Shick|date=2022-06-09|archivedate=20220614191603}}
